cases.note: Re-probed 2026-07-11 (FA fix 1 classify re-sweep): still blocked. CapControl.ControlSignal is not ported -> the CapControl samples with no monitored element set and the solve aborts ("Monitored element not set" -> "Solution aborted"). Genuine unported property.

Re-probed 2026-07-11 (FA fix 1 classify re-sweep): NOT a class/feature gap. The file begins with a UTF-8 BOM (U+FEFF) that the Rust executive does not strip before the first command, so the first line parses as "\ufeffClear" -> "Unknown Command". A parser BOM-handling gap (the oracle strips the BOM). Flagged as a real, in-scope-adjacent bug for follow-up.
